name: market-opportunity-research
title_zh: 德语市场周报生成器，四类资产筛完直接落本地
tagline_zh: 不碰你的持仓，只筛股票、ETF/ETC、加密、大宗，生成带来源的德语观察清单。
tagline_en: Screens stocks, ETFs/ETCs, crypto, commodities—no portfolio tailoring—then writes a sourced German watchlist into.
desc_en: Research current non-personalized market opportunities across listed stocks, retail-accessible ETFs and ETCs, major crypto assets, and commodities, then publish a sourced German watchlist report to the local Portfolio Analyser. Use for general investment ideas and market screens; do not inspect or tailor conclusions to the user's portfolio.
why_zh: 它把「市场扫描」和「个人持仓」彻底分开：结论不掺你的仓位，来源可溯，德语输出直接对接本地工具。
why_en: Keeps market screening separate from your portfolio—no bias, traceable sources, German output wired straight into your local tool.
limit_zh: 只认德语输出，且只写进本地 Portfolio Analyser；不分析你的持仓，不给买卖建议。
limit_en: German output only, writes solely to local Portfolio Analyser; ignores your holdings, no buy/sell advice, no private assets or derivatives.
title_en: German watchlist report from 4-asset market screens
